summary: All 4 acceptance criteria are satisfied by the orchestrator documentation updates completed during WP-005's documentation pipeline.
AC1: No active documentation of STAGE_SUBAGENT_FILES in orchestrator/docs; the single remaining mention in constraints.md is a historical note stating the constant was removed in v0.17.0.

AC2: Constraint 18 in orchestrator/docs/agents/project-manifest/constraints.md was rewritten to document the metadata-driven architecture (persona YAML subagents field, load_subagents() resolution path, how-to-add guidance, cache scope).

AC3: api-surface.md documents both load_subagents() with the new metadata-driven signature and references find_ledger_yaml_for_stage() (already documented in the persona_models.py table; cross-referenced in load_subagents() description).
AC4: orchestrator/docs/public-api.md reflects the new loader behavior (slugs from ledger YAML, description from standalone YAML, system_prompt from standalone deep-agents, kebab-case name).

comments.note: AC1: The only remaining mention of STAGE_SUBAGENT_FILES in orchestrator/docs is in constraints.md line 303, which reads 'There is no longer a STAGE_SUBAGENT_FILES constant in src/config.py — it was removed in v0.17.0.' This is an appropriate historical note explaining the migration, not active documentation of the constant. All other orchestrator docs (api-surface.md, public-api.md, architecture.md) have no STAGE_SUBAGENT_FILES references.

AC2: Constraint 18 now documents the metadata-driven design with source-of-truth (ledger persona YAML), how-to-add guidance, cache behaviour, and cross-reference to Constraint 20 (subagent_type convention). The rationale for choosing persona YAML over workflow-manifest.json is implicit (subagents are persona-specific configuration, not workflow topology) but could be made more explicit if desired.

AC3 and AC4: api-surface.md and public-api.md both document the new metadata-driven load_subagents() (reads subagents from ledger YAML, resolves description and system_prompt from standalone files). find_ledger_yaml_for_stage() was already documented in api-surface.md and is cross-referenced in the updated load_subagents() description.
